SEARCH
Package net.ygbstudio.jbrave.core.domain

Interface SearchFilterOption

All Superinterfaces:
BraveAPIConstant, ProvidedOption, SearchOption
All Known Implementing Classes:
Freshness, ResultFilter, SafeSearch
public interface SearchFilterOption extends ProvidedOption
An interface representing a search filter.

This interface is extended by enums that represent search filters. SearchFilterOption also offers fields that are used to generate URL parameter combinations for the API requests.
